example.title: Farm silo along the Columbia River Highway

brief: Wide concrete stave silo about 22 ft across and 60 ft high, built of large pale-grey rectangular staves with crisp joint lines and a grid of thin steel hoops. A shallow conical roof of rust-red corrugated metal with a small cap, a caged steel ladder and door chute column running up the front, and a galvanized fill pipe that climbs the side and arcs over in a big gooseneck into the roof, guyed by cables.
